name: ak:scenario
overview: Generate comprehensive edge cases and test scenarios by decomposing features across 12 dimensions. Use for pre-implementation risk discovery, QA planning, regression design, and iterative saturation when coverage must be exhaustive.
whenToUse: Invoke to expand requirements into edge cases and QA scenarios.

flags.name: --saturation
flags.desc: stop when 2 consecutive iterations produce zero `New` classifications

flags.name: --iterations N
flags.desc: Bounded loop: run exactly N iterations, then stop with summary

flags.name: --domain <type>
flags.desc: Domain hint: software, product, business, security, marketing

flags.name: --focus <dim>
flags.desc: Prioritize dimension: edge-cases, failures, security, scale

flags.name: --format <type>
flags.desc: Output format: table, use-cases, test-scenarios, threat-scenarios
